name: Process Timeline
summary: Named, intrinsically responsive ordered process lane with visible numbering and optional target-owned media.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native process-timeline section named by its visible contextual heading.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible process heading that labels the section and ordered lane.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.description: Native ordered one-row lane that distributes available inline space and scrolls horizontally when its steps do not fit.

anatomy.name: step
anatomy.description: Direct repeated ordered-list item supplied by the target.

anatomy.name: stepNumber
anatomy.description: Visible generated sequence marker hidden from assistive technology because the native ordered list exposes position.

anatomy.name: stepImage
anatomy.description: Optional passive step media region omitted completely when no image is supplied.

anatomy.name: stepImageMedia
anatomy.description: Native step image supplied by the target with context-appropriate alternative text.

anatomy.name: stepTitle
anatomy.description: Required contextual heading for one process stage.

anatomy.name: stepDescription
anatomy.description: Optional concise explanation of one process stage.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Equal intrinsic tracks expand when supplied steps fit and form one horizontally scrollable lane when they do not.

states.name: default
states.description: Required title and ordered step composition with any accepted optional step content.

states.name: trackFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the native lane so overflowing content can be scrolled without a pointer.

behavior.name: orderedSteps
behavior.description: Adapters use a native ordered list with direct list items and preserve authored process order independently of available inline space.

behavior.name: sectionLabelling
behavior.description: The native section and ordered lane reference a target-unique id on the same visible contextual heading; heading rank remains owned by the surrounding document.

behavior.name: nativeOverflow
behavior.description: The one-row lane distributes free inline space and uses native horizontal overflow and snap only when supplied steps exceed it. Targets ensure an overflowing lane is sequentially focusable without intercepting native scroll keys.

behavior.name: visibleSequence
behavior.description: Every step has a visible generated decimal marker. It is aria-hidden to avoid duplicating the position already exposed by native ordered-list semantics; decorative connectors never carry order alone.

behavior.name: optionalStepContent
behavior.description: Optional image and description parts are independently omitted without empty wrappers or changes to the required number/title order.

behavior.name: imageAlternative
behavior.description: Targets provide concise useful alternative text for informative step images or an empty alternative for decorative media and retain step meaning when media is absent.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Localized, unbroken, zoomed, short, long and repeated content remains contained; only the named lane can scroll horizontally.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: Process Timeline owns no controlled or uncontrolled state, listener, observer, custom key handling, live region, animation, asset or network work. Data and media loading remain target responsibilities.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Visible process heading used as the section and ordered-lane label; its contextual native heading level remains target-owned.

properties.name: steps
properties.description: Ordered target-owned process-step composition with required titles and optional media/descriptions.

accessibility: Associate the native section and ordered lane with the same visible contextual heading through a target-unique aria-labelledby/id pair.
Use a native ordered list with direct list items and preserve authored source order across every available inline size.
Keep the visible decimal marker aria-hidden because native ordered-list semantics expose the same position; never rely on connector decoration or scroll position for sequence.
Ensure an overflowing lane is sequentially keyboard reachable with visible focus and preserve native arrow and Space scrolling without custom key handlers.
Use native heading levels appropriate to the surrounding document for the timeline and each step title; visual classes do not mandate h2 or h3.
Give informative step media concise useful alternative text, use alt="" when it is decorative, and omit optional media/description wrappers when absent.
Allow localized, unbroken, repeated and 200-percent-zoom content to reflow without page-level horizontal overflow.
Do not add Timeline widget, progress, carousel, current-step, selection, live-region, controlled-state or auto-advance semantics.

web.notes: Implemented in components/css/storytelling.css with native ordered semantics and intrinsic one-row overflow.

shopify.notes: Dedicated merchant-configurable Liquid section maps ordered blocks, optional image/description content, editor attributes, localized labels and native overflow without target runtime.
